_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the primary, market-neutral head term across all /es/ pages; it is the umbrella term for the whole product, not tied to one region.
phrases.good_example: Letras bonitas para copiar y pegar · Cursivas, aesthetic y símbolos para Instagram, TikTok y WhatsApp
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — this is the safe default term

phrases.content_surface: homepage FAQ answer, use-case card body copy
phrases.usage_guidance: Keep confined to body/FAQ/example text on the broad /es/ pages (as currently done) — do not promote to H1/title on the neutral homepage; safe as a dedicated term on an es_MX-specific spoke if one is ever built.
phrases.good_example: "Free Fire: en el nick del personaje. Aquí lo que más se usa son letras chidas, góticas, símbolos..." (es/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use as the primary H1/title term on the broad, neutral /es/ homepage or hub pages — reserve for MX-specific contexts/examples.

phrases.content_surface: answer page H1/meta, FAQ items, guide body copy
phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for the tofu-rendering answer page; safe to use as H1. Converges identically across all three markets — no regional variant needed.
phrases.good_example: "¿Por Qué Mi Nombre Sale Como Cuadros o Signos de Interrogación?" (es/answers/por-que-mi-nombre-sale-como-cuadros H1)

phrases.english_concept: invisible character used to fake a blank name
phrases.content_surface: dedicated tool page title/H1, answer page
phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for the invisible-character tool; converges across markets.
phrases.good_example: "Texto Invisible & Carácter Invisible" (es/texto-invisible H1); "usa la herramienta de copiar texto para copiar un espacio en blanco" (vidaextra.com, fetched)

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for the 'how to' answer page; pair with the caveat that a 100% empty field is usually rejected (needs one filler char).
phrases.good_example: "Cómo Hacer un Nombre en Blanco (Invisible)" (es/answers/como-hacer-un-nombre-en-blanco H1)

phrases.usage_guidance: Safe broad head term; converges across markets (also the exact phrasing used across multiple Taringa.net threads from ~15 years of LATAM forum history).
phrases.good_example: "Convierte tu texto en letras raras y símbolos Unicode únicos" (es/letras-raras hero-sub)

phrases.usage_guidance: Keep 'aesthetic' untranslated — this matches universal practice across the whole Spanish-language web (Canva ES/MX, every competitor site); a Spanish calque ('estético') would read as wrong/awkward and was not found anywhere in the wild.
phrases.good_example: "¿Qué son las letras aesthetic y por qué se ven así?" (es/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: Do not translate 'aesthetic' to 'estético/a' — not attested anywhere in native usage.

phrases.usage_guidance: Safe broad term; also confirmed used identically in MX-hosted editorial content (Canva ES/MX 'letras góticas' guide).
phrases.good_example: "Letras góticas para copiar y pegar" (es/letras-goticas title)

phrases.native_phrase: nombre de usuario / nombre en pantalla
phrases.usage_guidance: This distinction is confirmed independently by mainstream Spanish tech editorial (unocero.com, infobae.com) using the same two terms — safe, correct, no regional variant.
phrases.good_example: "¿Dónde Funcionan las Fuentes Elegantes — Usuario o Nombre en Pantalla?" (es/answers/nombre-de-usuario-o-nombre-en-pantalla H1)

phrases.native_phrase: por qué rechazaron mi nombre en el juego
phrases.english_concept: game rejected/wouldn't save the styled name
phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for this answer page; confirmed by independent research that Free Fire's real error text is literally 'Nombre no válido' — consider surfacing that exact phrase since it's what users see and search for verbatim.
phrases.good_example: "¿Por Qué Rechazaron Mi Nombre en el Juego?" (es/answers/por-que-rechazaron-mi-nombre-en-el-juego H1)

phrases.content_surface: FAQ item on the name-rejected answer page
phrases.usage_guidance: Correct, standard in-game economy term — use verbatim; pairs well with the checker-tool pitch ('validate before spending a card').
phrases.good_example: "¿Cómo evito desperdiciar una tarjeta de cambio de nombre?" (es/answers/por-que-rechazaron-mi-nombre-en-el-juego FAQ)

phrases.usage_guidance: Use verbatim — matches the language Roblox's own validator/community uses.
phrases.good_example: "¿Por qué Roblox dice que mi nombre tiene caracteres no compatibles?" (es/answers/por-que-rechazaron-mi-nombre-en-el-juego FAQ)

phrases.usage_guidance: Correctly distinguishes 'name genre/idea' (nombres aesthetic) from 'font style' (letras aesthetic, ES-007) — keep the distinction rather than merging the two pages.
phrases.good_example: "Nombres aesthetic ⋆｡˚ para copiar y pegar — Instagram, TikTok y juegos" (es/usecase/nombres-aesthetic title)

phrases.native_phrase: letras para tatuajes / conversor de letras para tatuajes
phrases.usage_guidance: Matches real forum demand: Mediavida and Forocoches threads show people seeking font/style advice before a name tattoo; this term is the correct, natural way that demand is phrased.

phrases.native_phrase: Feliz Día del Amor y la Amistad
phrases.content_surface: answer page FAQ body copy, alongside the neutral primary term
phrases.usage_guidance: This is a model example of correct regional handling per site policy: the page's title/H1 stays on the neutral 'San Valentín', while 'Feliz Día del Amor y la Amistad' is offered as one of the ready-to-use MX-flavored phrase options inside the body — exactly where a regional variant belongs.
phrases.good_example: "'Feliz San Valentín' sirve casi para cualquier persona... 'Feliz Día del Amor y la Amistad'" (es/answers/que-escribir-en-una-tarjeta-de-san-valentin FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: Do not promote to the page H1/title — 'San Valentín' should stay primary since it's understood everywhere, MX included.

phrases.english_concept: character limit on a game/platform name field
phrases.content_surface: implicit in FAQ (caracteres cuentan como más de un carácter) but not a dedicated 'límite de caracteres' term
phrases.usage_guidance: Confirms and cross-checks the game-rules.js RULES table for Free Fire (limit: 12) against independent editorial sources — matches. Also surfaces that some styled symbols count as more than one character toward the limit, which the existing FAQ item ('¿Los caracteres elegantes cuentan como más de un carácter en el nombre de un juego?') already addresses correctly.
phrases.good_example: "tu nick puede tener hasta 12 caracteres y cada espacio invisible cuenta como uno" (vidaextra.com, fetched, on Free Fire)

phrases.content_surface: homepage FAQ ('¿Cuál es la diferencia entre letras, fuentes y tipografía?')
phrases.usage_guidance: Confirmed as a distinct, correctly-scoped term from 'letras bonitas' by independent editorial sources (abcdario.org, letrasencursivas.com) explaining cursiva = the handwriting-style characteristic (slant, continuous stroke), while 'bonitas' is the broader decorative umbrella — the site's own FAQ answer already draws this distinction correctly.
phrases.good_example: "Letras es la palabra más usada en español... Fuente y tipografía se refieren más bien al diseño tipográfico" (es/index.html FAQ)

phrases.usage_guidance: Correct, precise term for a genuinely Discord-specific mechanic (distinct from the general tofu/rejection problem) — good example of platform-specific depth beyond generic 'nombre rechazado' coverage.
phrases.good_example: "Un nombre de Discord con estilo puede fallar igualmente tres pruebas silenciosas: la lista de miembros, la @mención y el filtro de suplantación" (es/guide/nombre-discord-sin-riesgos meta description)

phrases.english_concept: repetition handwriting sheets ('write this line over and over')
phrases.usage_guidance: The single best es_MX head term for a handwriting-practice-sheet generator: 'planas de caligrafía para imprimir' names the exact artefact a Mexican parent has in mind. It supports, and does not compete with, a broader 'caligrafía para imprimir' target.
phrases.good_example: Genera planas de caligrafía con el nombre de tu hijo y descárgalas en PDF.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use in es_ES copy — in Spain 'plana' primarily reads as 'flat/page' and the drill is called a 'ficha de caligrafía'. Avoid where the tone is anti-rote: 'planas' carries a mild connotation of repetitive punishment-style homework for some Mexican adults, so do not use it in copy arguing that practice should be playful.
